description: This file defines a Spring Batch configuration class for sending asynchronous events, including bean definitions for a job and its step, utilizing dependency injection for job repository, transaction management, and a tasklet.

classes.name: SendAsynchronousEventsConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up a batch job and step for asynchronous event processing.

methods.name: sendAsynchronousEventsStep
methods.description: Defines a step for sending asynchronous events, built with a tasklet and linked to the job repository.

methods.name: sendAsynchronousEventsJob
methods.description: Defines the batch job that orchestrates the step, with an incrementer for run IDs.
